data.raw_text:
A deeper look into @codexfx and prediction of real use cases.

Unlocking Bangladesh Remittances: $32.8 Billion Inflows, Billions Lost to FX Spreads.

Bangladesh recorded a historic $32.81 billion in remittances in 2025, up 22% from 2024, powering reserves and households amid economic pressures.Yet hidden FX spreads and fees erode 3-6% ($1-2 billion annually), mirroring global payment opacity you've explored.

Codex, a stablecoin-native Ethereum L2, scales to reclaim those losses via low-cost on-chain settlement, as proven in its @pdaxph partnership for Philippines remittances.

Expatriates sent $32.81 billion home in 2025, with peaks like $3.29 billion in March and $3.22 billion in December driven by incentives, patriotism post-2024 shifts, and formal channel shifts from hundi. Despite this, traditional banks and exchanges pocket 2-4% FX spreads plus 1-2% fees, totaling $1.3-1.6 billion lost yearly on $33 billion flows. 

Opaque pricing hides true costs, leaving recipients with 94-97% of sent value, per World Bank-aligned analyses.

@codexfx batches stablecoin transfers (USDC/USDT) on its OP Stack L2 for sub-cent fees ($0.01-0.10/tx) and on-chain FX at near-spot rates, slashing total costs to 0.2-0.5%. For Bangladesh's volume, 50% adoption preserves $900 million+ annually by bypassing intermediaries, nostro accounts, and delays scaling to millions of daily tx via Ethereum security. Predictable stablecoin-denominated gas ensures no congestion spikes, unlike @base @ethereum.

In October 2025, Philippines exchange @pdaxph partnered with @codexfx to power stablecoin remittances, targeting $38 billion OFW inflows with identical pain points (5-7% costs). Codex enables instant USDC swaps to PHP at minimal spreads, cutting per-$1K transfers from $50-70 to $2-5 early pilots report "game-changing" efficiency for high-volume corridors. Bangladesh could replicate this via diaspora apps on Codex, preserving $1.5 billion at full scale.

@codexfx's compliance tools and EVM compatibility position it for Bangladesh Bank pilots, blending DeFi speed with regulatory trust to end remittance erosion.

This is just a example of how @codexfx can help  third world countries to save money from global fx spreading and erosion which whipped out billions annually. 

Existing banking system less often speak on this matter and filled up there Pocket. 

#defi
#codexpbc
